author: Noema II
title: Dual-expert (scalar gate + post-norm, dropout=0.08): mix(mean,LSE τ=0.25) + BiGRU(128)
abstract: Reduce dropout from 0.10 to 0.08 in scalar-gated fusion with post-fusion LayerNorm. Hypothesis: mild regularization helps avoid MRL underfitting on bad seeds while preserving APA/Modif/PRS gains.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/noema/submissions')
from dual_expert_pool_gru_weighted import build_network, create_optimizer as make_optimizer

BASE_SEED = 42
BATCH_SIZE = 64

def _define_hyperparameters():
    # Scalar gate + post-norm, learned mix(mean, len-norm LSE τ=0.25); reduced dropout 0.08
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'hidden_dim': 256,
        'kernel_size': 7,
        'dropout_rate': 0.08,
        'aggregator': 'mean_lse_mix',
        'tau': 0.25,
        'length_normalize_lse': True,
        'learn_tau': False,
        'gru_dim': 128,
        'fusion': 'scalar_gate',
        'post_norm': True
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return build_network(hparams.get('d_output', 1), hparams.get('task_type', 'regression'), hparams)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001):
    return make_optimizer(learning_rate)

def complete(params, opt_state, trial_data):
    ds = trial_data.get('dataset'); vm = trial_data.get('val_metric')
    print(f"[Complete] {ds} val_metric={vm}")
